gloss: playing and singing at the same time (esp. solo)

definitions.gloss: playing and singing at the same time (esp. solo)
definitions.explanation: A solo performance in which one person both plays an instrument (typically guitar or piano) and sings. The performer accompanies themselves, with no separate vocalist or backing band.

examples.japanese: ギターで{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りをする。
examples.english: I sing while playing the guitar.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のピアノ{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りは{心|こころ}に{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: Her piano-and-vocal performance struck a chord with me.

examples.japanese: ライブハウスでは{若|わか}いミュージシャンが{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りで{自作|じさく}の{歌|うた}を{披露|ひろう}していた。
examples.english: At the live house, young musicians were performing their own songs solo on instrument and vocals.

notes:
Compound of {弾|ひ}く (to play a stringed/keyed instrument) + {語|かた}る (to narrate, recite). The {語|かた}る element preserves an older sense of "singing a narrative," though today it covers any singing accompanied by self-played instrument.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ギター{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り: solo guitar-and-vocal performance
- ピアノ{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り: solo piano-and-vocal performance
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りライブ: a solo singer-musician live show
- {弾|ひ}き{語|がた}りで{歌|うた}う: to sing while accompanying oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弾|ひ}く: to play (a stringed/keyed instrument) — just the playing
- {歌|うた}う: to sing — just the singing
- アコースティックライブ: acoustic live — overlapping but broader; may have multiple performers
